title: National parks, December 2020 (Great Britain, generalised, clipped)
description: The 15 national parks of England, Wales and Scotland.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "National_Parks_December_2020_Boundaries_GB_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/National_Parks_December_2020_Boundaries_GB_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 15 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
